hypothesis: The parent (c003) clamps the per-region density weight at 5 and slows its growth, which eases buffer insertion but leaves residual overlap in dense regions; instead of only capping the weight, make the update *stop earlier* by raising the per-region stop criterion slightly (so regions that are already nearly overflow-free stop inflating their density penalty) while keeping the gentler 1.02/1.03 growth — this reduces over-spreading in already-clean regions (helps bp_fe which regressed) without removing the whitespace benefit ariane133/bp gained.
analysis: The hypothesis held: raising the per-region stop criterion while keeping gentle 1.02/1.03 growth improved all three cases (robust +0.081, min +0.088, all valid). bp_fe recovered (+0.136, dTNS +21.7%), consistent with reduced over-spreading in already-clean regions; ariane133 (+0.088, dWNS +4.4%) and bp (+0.088, dWNS +16.5%) retained whitespace benefit. Next step: sweep the stop-criterion threshold (e.g., 1.02/1.03 vs 1.05/1.06) to find the knee balancing bp_fe recovery against ariane/bp overflow gains.
